candidates.name: Ischemic stroke
support_spans: acute speech disturbance and right-sided weakness
Noncontrast head CT showed early ischemic changes in the left insula and frontal lobe
candidates.why: Patient presented with symptoms consistent with ischemic stroke and imaging confirmed early ischemic changes

candidates.name: Aortic stenosis
support_spans: severe low-gradient aortic stenosis with preserved ejection fraction
candidates.why: Transthoracic echocardiography revealed severe aortic stenosis

candidates.name: Cardioembolic stroke
support_spans: persistent atrial fibrillation
acute occlusion of the left middle cerebral artery
candidates.why: Atrial fibrillation is a known risk factor for cardioembolic stroke

candidates.name: Thrombotic stroke
support_spans: chronic occlusion of the left internal carotid artery
candidates.why: Chronic occlusion of the internal carotid artery may have contributed to thrombotic stroke

candidates.name: Pulmonary embolism
support_spans: CT angiography of the chest showed pulmonary emboli in segmental arteries of the right lower lobe

candidates.name: Cerebral vasculitis
support_spans: mild pleocytosis (10 cells/µL) and elevated protein (55 mg/dL) with normal glucose in cerebrospinal fluid analysis
contradict_spans: Vasculitic, autoimmune, viral infection, and malignancy screens were unremarkable
candidates.why: Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed mild pleocytosis and elevated protein, but vasculitis screens were unremarkable
